notes.title: Hotfix patch 1.1.2.11
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I've released a hotfix patch to address some issues.

Fixed the effect not visible when the reflector hit a Huge asteroid.
Pressing the home button on the gamepad will pause in Big picture mode.

notes.title: ASTRO ACE Halloween Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
ASTRO ACE has been updated to v 1.1.0 for Halloween.


Halloween Invaders

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40513603/f2aa0b5cf7d9a3a6c0d62e91d683014c4686c422.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40513603/b3381d70f4e71c8298f9ac8ab27a2cb0984e70be.jpg
On a spooky October day, pumpkins attack Earth with an alien fleet. Destroy the pumpkins and get candy. 
Halloween invaders are Unlocked at level 5 and are only playable during October. Don't miss out on related achievements. You can switch to the original mode on the main menu. 


New fighter

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40513603/3d6f22e218399c3298a91ecf39f1f355b5661d50.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40513603/e7120f7cc68e9d0911c964fd9e64f9d0ecd2c024.jpg
The Sova was originally a trainer spacecraft designed for recruits. As the number of fighters became insufficient due to endless attacks by the alien fleet, it was upgraded to a combat type and put into service, mainly to assist other fighters. It has a weak hull and small capacity, but its small size and stable speed are its advantages. Unlocked at level 2.


New weapon

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40513603/e6e7fd51bd1f24cc88d83be9257f1c963bea896f.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40513603/152e0c31367edca8f87244997095fd209987ac6d.gif
The Spreader is a weapon that has low damage but can attack a wide area quickly.
Unlocked at level 21 in the hangar and appears randomly in-game.


Balance changes

The boost self-recharge rate of the BF-9 has been increased.
Slightly reduced the duration of weapon icons in-game.

Bug fix

Fixed an issue where the effect was not displayed properly when taking damage.

notes.title: Update v 1.0.0 Released.
notes.content:
ASTRO ACE has been updated to v 1.0.0

Balance change
- Now for beginners, a small number of enemies will appear until level 5.

Bug fixes
- Fixed a crashing issue when pausing for a long time.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes laser damage was not applied.
- Fixed an issue where text lines were sometimes displayed differently when game over.
